{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TOUGHNESS 28-32 HRC"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT
AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block specifies heat treatment as '28-32 HRC' while note N3 on page 1 states '24-32 HRC', creating a conflict about the required hardness range. This ambiguity can lead to parts being accepted or rejected incorrectly during inspection. The designer should align both references to a single, consistent hardness specification.","recommended_correction":"Update either the title block heat_treatment field or note N3 so that both specify the same hardness range (e.g., 28-32 HRC)."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH  :  I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N8","page":1,"quote":"M30 x 1.5 x 25 DEEP MAJOR DIA-0.1"}],"comment":"The part requires an I.Z.B.P. plating finish (note N2) and includes an M30 x 1.5 thread with a tight major diameter tolerance of -0.1 mm (note N8), but there is no instruction to allow for plating thickness on the thread. Plating buildup will cause the finished thread to exceed its specified size, preventing proper assembly with mating nuts or threaded holes. The designer should add a note specifying pre-plate thread dimensions or explicitly state that the given tolerance accounts for the plating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note indicating that the M30 x 1.5 thread dimensions are pre-plate sizes, or adjust the tolerance to accommodate the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
